items.evidence: check-cw09-tasks-final.log: 22 SQLite repository tests passed. Coverage proves no run starts without both durable scope approval and proceed authority; authority consumption and run creation roll back together on failure; TaskSpec revisions remain immutable including direct INSERT OR REPLACE; invalidation authority is same-Task terminal-only; valid v1 migration succeeds and invalid legacy authority rolls back atomically; reopen preserves run, settings, message/delivery, shell, and takeover history.
